description: Source code for the X509Certificate class handling certificate parsing, validation, and encoding within the Chromium project.

classes.name: X509Certificate
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate, providing methods for parsing, validation, encoding, and comparison.

methods.name: CreateFromBuffer
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate object from a crypto buffer and intermediates.

methods.name: CreateFromBufferUnsafeOptions
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate with additional unsafe options.

methods.name: CreateFromDERCertChain
methods.description: Creates a certificate chain from DER-encoded certificates.

methods.name: CreateFromDERCertChainUnsafeOptions
methods.description: Creates a certificate chain from DER-encoded certificates with unsafe options.

methods.name: CreateFromBytes
methods.description: Creates a certificate from raw byte data.

methods.name: CreateFromBytesUnsafeOptions
methods.description: Creates a certificate from raw byte data with unsafe options.

methods.name: CreateFromPickle
methods.description: Creates a certificate from a pickle iterator.

methods.name: CreateFromPickleUnsafeOptions
methods.description: Creates a certificate from a pickle iterator with unsafe options.

methods.name: CreateCertificateListFromBytes
methods.description: Parses multiple certificates from byte data, handling PEM and DER formats.

methods.name: GetPEMEncodedFromDER
methods.description: Encodes DER data into PEM format.

methods.name: GetPEMEncoded
methods.description: Encodes a certificate buffer into PEM format.

methods.name: GetPEMEncodedChain
methods.description: Encodes the certificate chain into PEM format.

methods.name: GetPublicKeyInfo
methods.description: Extracts public key information from a certificate.

methods.name: CalculateFingerprint256
methods.description: Calculates the SHA-256 fingerprint of a certificate.

methods.name: CalculateChainFingerprint256
methods.description: Calculates the SHA-256 fingerprint of the entire certificate chain.

methods.name: VerifyHostname
methods.description: Verifies if a hostname matches the certificate's SANs.

methods.name: VerifyNameMatch
methods.description: Checks if a hostname matches the certificate's SANs.

methods.name: IsSelfSigned
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is self-signed.
